mods.name: Figura Crash Fix
mods.description: Stops Figura from throwing you back to the main menu when you reload resource packs. A Figura avatar texture that is closed while a resource reload is already running throws "Image is not allocated", vanilla then drops every selected resource pack, and every further attempt keeps failing until the game is restarted. This mod turns that one failure into a missing texture and unregisters the dead texture, leaving every other resource pack error untouched.

releases.notes:
Stops Figura from throwing you back to the main menu when you reload resource packs.

A Figura avatar texture that gets closed while a resource reload is already running throws `Image is not allocated`, vanilla then drops every selected resource pack, and every further attempt keeps failing until the game is restarted. This mod turns that one failure into a missing texture and unregisters the dead texture, leaving every other resource pack error untouched.

Minecraft 1.21.8, Fabric, client side. Figura is not required: without it the guard never fires.

**Still being tested.** It holds up in a dev client, but it has not had a long run on a live server yet, so problems are possible.
